author: FluentGpu
name: FluentGpu app
description: A FluentGpu desktop app (NativeAOT, Direct3D 12): a Mica window with the custom-frame TitleBar and one page, built against a FluentGpu engine checkout through FluentGpu.App.props.

EnginePath.description: Path of the FluentGpu engine checkout (the folder holding FluentGpu.App.props). Absolute, or relative to the new project folder. Change it later in Directory.Build.props or a git-ignored EngineRoot.local.props.

GlobalJson.description: Add a global.json that pins the .NET 10 SDK feature band the engine builds with (10.0.300, latestFeature). Turn off when the folder already sits under a global.json.
